## How it was checked
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] for visual changes: before/after stills (demo seed + `t`), no real-session screenshots
- [ ] for scene changes: `npm run verify:capture` passes (determinism)
- [ ] new signals documented in docs/PRIMITIVES.md or docs/EXERCISES.md with their certainty
- [ ] nothing new leaves the machine, or docs/PRIVACY_SECURITY.md is updated with a test
